top_categories.workout_context: 71ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Kuala Lumpur's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
5,663ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
At mile 60 of 80, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Kuala Lumpur. Train it until it feels boring.
At GFNY Kuala Lumpur, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Kuala Lumpur. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 80 miles.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 80 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 5,663ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Kuala Lumpur. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
5,663ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Kuala Lumpur’s 80 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 80 miles of mixed terrain in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
